modes.label: Grayscale
modes.hint: Grayscale depth (near = bright, far = dark): the pass for compositing / ZDefocus / relight. in1 = footage (whole comp frame range, 30 s / 200 MB max). Prompt ignored.

modes.label: Float (EXR)
modes.hint: Float depth as an EXR sequence (R=G=B) for ZDefocus & co. -- no 8-bit banding. The model's relative depth (near = high, like Nuke's depth.Z), not metres and not 0-1. in1 = footage (whole comp frame range, 30 s / 200 MB max). Big: ~25 MB per 1080p frame on disk (R=G=B, 32-bit); the server keeps the float data only a few minutes, so Nuke downloads it right after the job (can take a while). If the float data is not available you get the 8-bit video instead. Prompt ignored.

modes.label: Turbo
modes.hint: Colour-coded depth (turbo) to check the result. in1 = footage (whole comp frame range, 30 s / 200 MB max). Prompt ignored.

modes.label: Inferno

modes.label: Viridis
modes.hint: Colour-coded depth (viridis). in1 = footage (whole comp frame range, 30 s / 200 MB max). Prompt ignored.
